en: A black‑and‑white view along a dirt road in a small town. Large leafy trees line both sides of the road; to the right is a wooden house with a porch and picket fence. Utility poles with overhead wires follow the road on the left. In the middle distance there is a church or chapel with a pointed steeple partly hidden by trees. Low hills or a small mountain rise in the background, with a faint structure or lookout on a ridge. The image has no printed caption or visible writing on its face.
